description: Modernize the Streamlit UI inside run_app() plus a new .streamlit/config.toml theme. Covers all 7 UX items: brand/theme + restrained CSS, responsive top-K catalog grid (consuming FEAT-001's latest_image_lookup_matches()), large single-image + before/after for edits, guided empty-state pills, live tool progress via st.status, trace-as-expander with full-width conversation, richer sidebar upload card, plus correctness/UX fixes (stable deterministic widget keys, friendly error cards, accessibility basics). DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 for the matches accessor and the matches result shape.
steps: Create .streamlit/config.toml with a [theme] table: premium-neutral base, one tasteful accent primaryColor, light backgroundColor/secondaryBackgroundColor, dark readable textColor, and a system/Google-font-stack font fallback. NO remote/webfont download. Must be valid TOML.

In frontend/app.py keep ALL module-scope pure helpers (build_upload_key, build_s3_uri, build_handoff, normalize_image, TraceCollector, INIT_MESSAGE) and the `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard EXACTLY import-safe; make every change inside run_app().

Item 1 (brand+theme): at the top of run_app inject restrained CSS via ONE st.markdown(..., unsafe_allow_html=True) call (rounded image corners, soft card shadows, pill suggestion buttons, tighter chat spacing; no @import of remote fonts). Replace st.title("Fashion Assistant") with a styled wordmark header + tagline "Your AI stylist — search the catalog, restyle your photos, dress for the weather".

Item 6 (trace+layout): remove the st.columns((5,4,1)) hack and the Trace checkbox in BOTH the history loop and the live-turn block; render assistant messages full width; put each message's trace text inside a collapsed st.expander("How I did this").

Item 2 (top-K grid): using FEAT-001's collector.latest_image_lookup_matches(), when matches exist render a responsive grid via st.columns (up to 3 cards per row) of cards — image downloaded via download_image/download_bytes from each match s3_uri (sized by use_container_width, larger than the old 200px), the name (generic caption when name is None), optional similarity hint from distance, and a per-card download button with STABLE key f"dl-{index}-{card}". Optionally offer a larger view gated on hasattr(st, "dialog"). Persist rendered matches into chat_entry so history re-renders with the same stable keys.

Item 3 (single-image render): for generate_image/inpaint/outpaint results discovered via collector.latest_ok_s3_uri(), render the result large; for inpaint/outpaint show the uploaded SOURCE and EDITED result side by side (before/after) via st.columns(2) with meaningful captions/alt text.

Item 4 (guided empty state): when chat_history holds only the INIT greeting, render 4-6 clickable pill suggestion buttons (stable keys) mapped to real tools ("Find me a floral summer dress", "What should I wear in London today?", "Change my photo background to a beach", "Recolor this jacket to navy", "Generate a minimalist autumn outfit"); clicking submits that text as the user's turn via the same path as st.chat_input.

Item 5 (live progress): wrap the agent(handoff) call in st.status(...) when hasattr(st, "status") else st.spinner(...); update the label from TraceCollector/hook tool-call announcements ("Searching the catalog…", "Generating a look…", "Checking the weather…"). Keep final response rendering intact.

Item 7 (upload panel): keep the uploader in the sidebar but as a styled card with a visible thumbnail, filename, and a "Remove image" button that clears img/previous_img/user_image/upload_key; show a subtle "image attached" indicator near the chat input. PRESERVE normalize_image + upload-to-uploads/<uuid>.png and build_handoff plain prose (NO <input_s3_uri> tags).

Correctness/UX: replace EVERY key=str(uuid.uuid4()) on download/widget keys with deterministic per-message/per-card keys. Keep ConfigError fail-fast as a clean st.error + st.stop(). For image-tool error envelopes (status=="error"), surface the human-readable `message` from the envelope as a friendly card (e.g. "Image generation isn't enabled yet — ask an admin to enable the Stability models") instead of a raw stack trace. Add meaningful alt/caption text and keep sufficient contrast.

Do NOT hardcode regions/bucket/index — read from settings/load_settings() as the current code does. Gate any newer Streamlit API (st.status, st.dialog) on hasattr with a graceful fallback. No new dependencies, no external fonts, no streamlit run, no real AWS.
acceptance_criteria: `python -c "import frontend.app"` imports with NO Streamlit page code executing (pure helpers at module scope stay side-effect-free; all page code inside run_app under __main__).
`python3 -m pytest -q` full suite stays green (no regression to backend/tests).
.streamlit/config.toml is valid TOML with a [theme] table containing primaryColor.
No `key=str(uuid.uuid4())` remains on any Streamlit widget in frontend/app.py (grep shows uuid.uuid4() only via build_upload_key for S3 keys, never on key=).

The page uses collector.latest_image_lookup_matches() to render a multi-card grid, st.expander for trace, st.columns for before/after edits, guided pills on empty state, and st.status (hasattr-gated) for live progress — verifiable by reading the rewritten run_app.
verification: cd /Users/erictole/demo/fashion-assistant-agent/.worktrees/frontend-modern-ux && python3 -c "import tomllib; d=tomllib.load(open('.streamlit/config.toml','rb')); assert 'theme' in d and 'primaryColor' in d['theme']; print('theme OK')"
findings: Implemented entirely inside run_app() in frontend/app.py; module-scope helpers (build_upload_key, build_s3_uri, build_handoff, normalize_image, TraceCollector, INIT_MESSAGE) and the __main__ guard are untouched and import-safe (top-level imports are only __future__, io, uuid, PIL — streamlit/boto3 import inside run_app). Created .streamlit/config.toml with a valid [theme] table (primaryColor #6C5CE7, light bg, dark textColor, font='sans serif', no remote fonts). All 7 UX items done: (1) one unsafe_allow_html CSS block + styled wordmark/tagline; (2) responsive top-K grid via collector.latest_image_lookup_matches() rendered 3 cards/row with use_container_width, name caption (falls back to 'Catalog match' when name is None), distance similarity hint, per-card download key f'dl-{msg_key}-{card_index}'; (3) single large generated image, and before/after via st.columns(2) for edits (edit_source = source image when a photo is attached); (4) guided empty-state pills (5 suggestions, keys pill-{i}) shown only when history is just INIT_MESSAGE — clicking sets st.session_state['pending_prompt'] which is consumed on the next run via the same path as st.chat_input; (5) live progress via st.status (hasattr-gated, falls back to st.spinner) with labels mapped from the newest tool name recorded this turn; (6) removed the (5,4,1) columns + Trace checkbox, assistant messages render full width, trace in a collapsed st.expander('How I did this'); (7) sidebar upload card with thumbnail + filename caption + 'Remove image' button (clears img/previous_img/user_image/upload_key) and a '📎 Image attached' indicator near chat input. normalize_image + upload-to-uploads/<uuid>.png and build_handoff plain prose preserved (no <input_s3_uri> tags). All widget/download keys are deterministic (hist-/live- msg_key + index); no key=str(uuid.uuid4()) remains. Tool error envelopes (status=='error') surfaced as a friendly st.error card via latest_error_message() scanning this turn's collector.results slice; ConfigError still fail-fast via st.error + st.stop(). History re-render uses render_assistant_message()/render_match_grid() so stored matches/images/trace reappear with the same stable keys (chat_entry persists 'matches', 'image', 'edit_source', 'error_message', 'trace'). No new deps, no network fonts, no AWS/cdk/streamlit run. Verification: python -c 'import frontend.app' OK; pytest 39 passed; tomllib theme OK; grep for key=str(uuid.uuid4()) empty. For integration/merge: both the parent-workspace frontend/app.py and the worktree copy exist — only the worktree file was edited; .streamlit/config.toml is a new untracked file that must be included in the merge.
